title: Machine-verifiable autonomous-frontier contract and evaluator
objective: Create the mandatory autonomous-frontier contract, strict tri-state evaluator, proof ceilings, external-block semantics, and adversarial meta-tests that mechanically govern all completion claims.
business_reason: Narrative progress cannot determine whether autonomous positive-value work remains or whether a stop is genuinely external.
acceptance: all mandatory domains have stable gates
each gate has all required contract fields
false PASS and BLOCKED_EXTERNAL cases fail
task graph preserves autonomous work despite external evaluator gates
rollback: Revert the FRONTIER-001 checkpoint to the prior RESEARCH-001 commit; do not remove or weaken mission/proof/external-authority constraints.
stop_budget: Complete only after the evaluator is structurally valid, mutation-tested, independently attacked, and integrated into repository tasks/state.
